Aug? notes.title: Chapter 3 Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Planetary Architects,

[/p][h1]It's Spring!💐[/h1][p]Well, it's actually almost summer but in the Nekokami universe, Spring is coming! In the season of growth, renewal and confusion, our Spring Council Member and her buddies are waiting to meet the company's latest rising star.

[/p][h3]Major Gameplay Changes📣[/h3][p]
 [b]Hill Tiles:[/b] Hill Tiles can now only be placed where there are at least two adjacent Tiles (of any type). This gives Hill Tiles a more unique gameplay identity.
 [b]Catcus Habitats:[/b] The Cat's favorite succulents now have a stricter size limit.
 [b]Flower Habitats:[/b] Kami Approval has slightly decreased. They are still as beautiful as ever.
[/p][h3]New Content🎁[/h3][p]
 [b]Chapter 2 Finale[/b]: Star System Pan
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/764c922f65457e68cba2510f67a3f7151dd98cf1.png"][/img] [b]New Hub Systems[/b]: Seat of Seasons, The Blooms, Sector 79, Galala Valley. New secrets of the universe will unfold!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/5d57115946c44628b6b44e53245a4fb1e93e3409.png"][/img] [b]New Star Systems[/b], each with unique gameplay: Udon'en, Garden of Oden, Tamago Reserve, Pastry, Pho, Katsu, Trials of ChaoFan
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/988b1b797e8116124e4b867befb22b1ed5944d2b.png"][/img]
 [b]14 new Kami Visitors[/b] and [b]8 new BGM tracks.[/b]
 We have proudly updated our Early Access Meter:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/ffe85c3b1950d4ae40df3f402469b4fc0a80c635.png"][/img][/p][h3]Other Improvements🎉[/h3][p]
 The mythical Golden People and Silver People now have a stronger ancient civilization aesthetic and will react to your planet creation with small docks, city gates etc.
 All cat portraits in Chapter 2 have been retouched and updated! You can now see their mesmerizing kawaii eyes much more clearly before they mess up your planet!
 Getting around the Milky Way🌌 will be much easier now. The Milky Way itself is better visualized, and administrators/key cats of each star systems are highlighted.
 Star Systems will now show certain important statuses - whether you are waiting for a colleague 📆, or a colleague is waiting for you, or you have earned a Certificate already .
 Continuous improvement on the localization.
 We have previously delivered various new functionality in Jan as well: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2840890/view/516326471563739593"][/dynamiclink]

[/p][h2]The Road Ahead🚀[/h2][p]With the work in these 9 months our tiny team of two has gained some first hand experience to better estimate the amount of work needed to bring Nekokami to version 1.0. We are glad to say that we have "leveled up" in our general production ability, BUT, at the same time, Chapter 4, our last chapter, is going to be huge.

Therefore, we’ve decided to extend the Early Access period slightly. The full 1.0 release is now planned for early 2026. 📅 Thank you for your patience and support!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/b58fcd26541386ded59081b1003682044c4d6fcd.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting the Early Access of Nekokami! Hope you have the best time with your colleagues and the Kami. 🌟 Please don't forget to report any bugs you encounter in your new adventures using our in-game link!


Rocket-in-Bottle Team[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 3 Progress, Part 5
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Planetary Architects,

Here we are, the last part of our progress update. Some of you may have started the journey when we first launched into Early Access. The feline folks and gods will be quite disappointed if your memory of them are already fading, but maybe it's a good idea to give a small summary of the story so far? 

[/p][h2]📃The Story So Far[/h2][p][i]Spoilers for existing content.[/i]

You started your career with [spoiler]our Caretaker greeting you at the office... with all the suspicious signals that he is "up to something"...?![/spoiler]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/721c4cf0e5890388cbf39a775f6e91c95a64be12.png"][/img]
Things spiral as you realize you are [spoiler]simply a magnet of Kami and they just love "helping out" in every one of your Expeditions...[/spoiler] be it a lush paradise, a desert, or a home for the Golden Humans. Oh, the tiny Golden fellows, loved by the Cats and Mr. Autumn, in particular.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/e2d20b147553454c77ec6c8b4e412b9b8bfa3999.png"][/img]
Did you manage to [spoiler]help Senpai on his troubles[/spoiler]? Well, there're greedy, virulent intelligent races unlike the Golden Humans. One species in particular expanded star system to star system until they [spoiler]met their doom under the wrath of the Kami[/spoiler]... 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/8ef729ee054ac4514fdfcd822287ef7ed41948f4.png"][/img]
As we reach the end of Chapter 2, your favorite AI, EYE, has informed you that Mr. Autumn is [spoiler]not alright[/spoiler]....

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/764c922f65457e68cba2510f67a3f7151dd98cf1.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]👻Surprises Along the Journey[/h2][p]We must again thank you the patience of our Early Access supporters. As you are probably aware, we are slightly behind schedule. This Content Update is significantly larger than the EA-launch gameplay, so for this novice duo of developers, the production of the Update has already been one very long journey full of surprises...

One surprise, for instance, happened when we create the artwork for our new characters - we realize that the original ones look,.. dull?! Blasphemy to our feline gods! Turns out that we need to go back and improve almost all of our existing artwork...

Now you will see more emotions from your best friends:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/2a20d890b9ecbefa84520d95dc76a25dff8af734.png"][/img]
You now know that Manager Sori is keeping some secrets when not saying sorry... Or Priest Collar is kind of really a priest...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/d98bddecea53a756faaa4d8800f49da80b6ca260.png"][/img]
And, wait, who is this?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/441892e62cf5bf3f422e94ef40577505fb7d0d65.png"][/img]
As the game get so much larger we also realize in our play testing that it is so easy to get lost now. We again then needed to take some time to improve the overall Milky Way experience...

Oh there are so much more. Can't wait to deliver this new Nekokami experience to you all!

Let me end the progress updates series with a farm field and a giant cat (?). Hope you enjoyed it and the new adventures will arrive very soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/b58fcd26541386ded59081b1003682044c4d6fcd.png"][/img]

Rocket-in-Bottle Team










[/p]

notes.title: Local Co-op Game Mode Update
notes.notes:
This is a functionality update. The new star systems, biomes and Chapter 3 content will arrive in the update AFTER this one.  

[h3]🤝Local Co-op Game Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Surprise! We had this experimental two-player game mode brewing for some time. Enjoy your Planetary adventure in the Nekokami universe with another human!
[*] The Co-op Game Mode, as the name suggests, is highly cooperative. Players will share the same Tile queue and take turns to create beautiful planets and meet the objectives. 
[*] At least one controller is required. Please see second part of the post for more details.
[/list]
[h3]🔥 Other New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Surveying a placed Tile will now show a mini-Hexagon with iconic representation of constituents of the Tile. 
[*] The star system display will now feature the associated main character(s). This will help players get around more easily.  
[/list]
[h3]🔧Bug Fixes and Other Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevent players from getting the "A Good Dream" achievement. 
[*] The landing animation has been further improved.
[*] Slight visual changes to Expeditions across the Milky Way.
[*] Polish over Chinese and Japanese localization in story dialog. We will keep improving them!
[/list]

[h2]🔰 How to Start Local Co-Op Mode[/h2]

When you arrive to the Main Menu Screen, you will now see a new option that allows you to assign controller to Player 1 or 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/d31474c14c7351655f3eae2fca9527c852259713.png[/img]

If you have one controller, you can activate Co-Op mode by assigning controller to Player 2. Player 1 will use keyboard & mouse.

If you have two controllers, you can determine who will be Player 1/2. To avoid conflicting controls, Player 1 gets the privilege to engage in dialogs 💬 and do various important actions in the UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/c9b4f5e5c42c5cab929a84059dc59dfc5b43218e.png[/img]

Start the game normally, and you'll now be enjoying Nekokami with 2 players! 

It's a highly cooperative mode - players get to place in turn. The two players can both preview the Tile they will be placing. We designed it this way so that none of the players will need to wait excessively - both players can plan for their placement while waiting. Of course, they can also coordinate their placement together!

Actually, you can switch your Tile in hand with that of your partner anytime... but remember to ask first, okay?  👻

If you happen to have tried the Co-op Mode sometime later, we welcome your feedback in the Steam Forums. Please let us know how it went!

notes.title: Chapter 3 Progress, Part 3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Planetary Architects,

[/p][h2]Schedule Update: Q1 2025 📅[/h2][p]First, a schedule update - the ETA for Chapter 3 is now [b]Q1 2025[/b]! We have all the gameplay ready, but we are still working hard to resolve bugs and catch up with the localization and music. We wish to stress that the content update will be BIG, and we need to make sure our Early Access players will have a smooth experience through the Chapter 2 finale and beyond. So, we must humbly ask for your patience. Thank you!

In this third post of the series, we will address one concern from some of our beloved Early Access players - why all planets so far are Earth-lookalikes? Where are our alien landscapes of a universe ruled by the Future Cats? 👽

[/p][h2]Onsen Biome ♨️[/h2][p]Let me introduce you to the Onsen Biome - a biome where Kami Energy is far too intense for general Human habitation. Excess Kami Energy crystallizes on the planet surface as Kaminites💎.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/d8ad44595c312ffa7b0f77ed9aaae03fd05c365d.png"][/img]Most of these planets have the most healing Onsens in the Milky Way. And of course the Kami knows that very well!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/6272ff50151f6bdf479685933e2e5046deaf8a98.png"][/img]Create the Osens to bring Luck to their visitors and yourself. Make sure the temperature is right, though. 

[/p][h2]Frontier Biome 🌄[/h2][p]The other one is the Frontier Biome. When planets are first formed physically, not even the Kami has arrived. Nekokami Co's mysterious high-tech networks🔮 has just started deploying...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/f3c0a6b0d81738cf500d41b4ce4bf1ea0569ebf4.png"][/img]Hm... the drawings look familiar... why are they all over the place...? 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/6b58e698bb3af36102b56a504d9ba43ff277e72a.png"][/img]And who are we summoning?!

Both of these Biomes will offer refreshing unique gameplay, such as[spoiler]adjusting Onsen temperature for the Kami, fixing Kami Energy pipelines, and even preparing for installation of EYE on planets (?)! [/spoiler] 

Don't worry. They all sound more challenging than they really are. If the Cats can do it, so can you!  

We can't wait to get you all to visit these wonderful planets 🚀. Thank you again for your support!



Rocket-in-Bottle Team
















[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 3 Progress, Part 2
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Planetary Architects,

In this second post of the series, we are going to look at two of the upcoming Biomes 🌵🌴🌲, both under management of our yet-to-reveal Spring Council Member.

One-third of our Nekokami experience is building soothing diorama of nature on deliciously named planets. Let's take a preview of the tranquil nature 🌰 you will create before the naughty cats try to steal the spotlight again?

[/p][h2]Fertile Biome🌾[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/b15a13c443ce74d911f28bfb562fc60bd6e066cd.png"][/img]The first Biome is the Fertile Biome 🌾, the "official" biome of Spring. The keywords for the Biome is [b]Variety[/b] and [b]Artisanry[/b]. Did you notice in the above planet, Bushes, Trees and Flowers come in more than one species? Arrangement of the different species, along with various rules over how Habitats should be formed, will determine your Artisanry of your Planetary Creation.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/f311c8d6445b64d0b7ad8dae4d792172a8f92a1f.png"][/img]Earn Artisanry Points and prove to the Kami your growth as Planetary Architect! The Artisanry system features a slower gameplay that rewards well crafted Habitats and patience. Kind of how gardening works actually.

[/p][h2]Jungle Biome 🌳[/h2][p]The second Biome is the Jungle Biome 🌳. The keywords for the biome is [b]Secrets[/b] and [b]Unknown[/b]. The Jungle is dense, and the planet is no longer yours alone. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/7098ca47e5e57855f19d8cd765832fc23fb61e6a.png"][/img]Navigating and creating Habitats in the dense Jungle can be challenging. There are Secrets to be Explored and Found. Now that's a genuine Expedition! One more thing.. they call the Kami there... "Others"... 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/576967f45cc199315e5a998822fa2740e8dbe986.png"][/img]Oh, did you notice the Mushrooms 🍄? True to the philosophy of the two Biomes, there are a total of FOUR species of them, each with their own characteristics! Some precious, some undesirable, some outright nasty! We will keep them a secret, for now.

Remember, that's only a preview of two of the many new mechanics you will encounter in Chapter 3. As per our tradition, we have a surprise🌋awaiting our Planetary Architect in every new star system!


Rocket-in-Bottle Team






  



[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 3 Progress, Part 1
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Planetary Architects,

It's about time we reveal more details about the upcoming Major Content Update, which we target to deploy before end of year.

Major Content Updates are big updates. In the Chapter 3 Update, you will get to catapult your career to new heights with:

🌱 Four brand new biomes, each with unique mechanics!
🌌 9 Playable Star Systems and 4 new destinations on the Milky Way!
🎶 10+ new Kami and Colleagues and lots and lots of cats!
🍄 Brand new gameplay mechanics that are challenging, relaxing or outright silly! 
🔧 Tons of UI and gameplay improvements
The update will push the total Story gameplay hours to 30 hours total. The quality control has become a little bit challenging for our two person team but we will try our best to keep the promise of delivering within Q4 of 2024!

[/p][h2]🍂 Chapter 2 Finale[/h2][p]
If you have already joined our Early Access, you will definitely know that the Chapter 3 Update will include the Chapter 2 Finale as well. [spoiler]You have probably saved poor Senpai, but will you be able to save Mr. Autumn?[/spoiler]

Our noble Golden People is in the center stage of our Chapter. We have upgraded their representation to better portray them as being technologically primitive but mythologically advanced at the same time. Behold their floating Golden Gardens!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/e2d20b147553454c77ec6c8b4e412b9b8bfa3999.png"][/img]
You can definitely tell them apart from our forest guardians (Olive People) now:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/189f578b23a9bbcbb28043da617e90ce9d3fa43d.png"][/img]
The Autumn Biome was our first biome and needed some love. The improvements can be subtle:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/bc432a9d62312be0ab97ad7deccdbb6ffcc50427.png"][/img]
We can't spoil anything else for the Chapter 2 Finale, so that's all for now. We will look at the one of the new biomes in the next post!


Rocket-in-Bottle Team



[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.5.5, plus Updated Early Access FAQ
notes.notes:
We have released Update 0.5.5 today!

[list]
[*]🐛 Fixed stamp display issue. Players will no longer see their stamps earned beyond the required maximum.
[*]🐛Several star map display and dialog issues have been fixed.
[*]📖Improved Japanese localization.
[*]🎶Professor Shoebox's theme music is now available.
[*]🔧Story Star Systems will now display a clear date (dd/mm/yyyy) when the content in the star system will refresh after you have finished all available planets.
[*] 🌱The first batch of Dream Cards has arrived to the Dream Garden! What is the Dream Garden? Please check out our FAQ below.
[*] 💻The Company Intranet has been updated.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/065e6fcb725990dd280811fdd41bb83470a54272.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Early Access FAQ:[/h2]

[h3]🌱How many hours of gameplay does the Dream Garden mode add?[/h3]
We won't officially count the gameplay hours for our Dream Garden mode. The Dream Garden is our version of Creative Mode, and based on the experience of Creative Modes of other games, some players may spend a lot of time in it, while some won't touch it at all. We have an introduction to the Dream Garden [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2840890/view/4259923998355226179]here[/url]. Or just have a try inside the game!

[h3]🔭What's the plan ahead?[/h3]
We will post on the Company Intranet regularly. A confirmed upcoming update is the Cloud Save. Please stay tuned.

[i]For our new potential players:[/i]

[h3]🌌Early Access is Risky! Will the game get finished?[/h3]
Well, Steam basically told us developers not to promise anything for certain—they are right, no one is a prophet. But in our case, we are self-funded, sustaining ourselves in a wonderful city in Japan, and financially and physically healthy. We love what we have here and definitely want to see it finished. 

[h3]😖Will I LOSE my game save during the Early Access process?[/h3]
Again, Steam says, don't promise anything 100% certain in the future. So we will say, our save file is kind of... simple, and we have NO intention to disrupt or reset the game progress from Early Access to full launch. In the worst case, the save file always knows which chapter and star system you are in. :P

[h3]🌵I am still hesitant![/h3]
It's perfectly fine! A game needs involvement from the community in all stages of development.

We actually have a Nekokami Early Access Current State meter that we update regularly so you can see how we are doing at a very simple glance:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/f1abe322cc4f040e6af0be649eccf82cf7767f9d.png[/img]

And if you click on Follow on our store front page, you will be notified of our development updates. Just hop in when you are ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/f8a578caed6cd8c837273c03082d40b391f74ba7.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Dream Garden Update🌱
notes.notes:
[i]This is a preview of our upcoming update.[/i]

The Dream Garden🌱 is a secondary game mode for Nekokami. It is somewhat a mix of Creative Mode and an alternate, interruption-free gameplay mode. 

Not being part of the main story, the Dream Garden allows for ideas and gameplay that would otherwise be impossible within our story setting. The structure of the Dream Garden is also designed to encourage the creators (us) and our players to experiment. What does this Dream Card do?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/bc5b964043ed2ce69d781383a28ee8b8b0513b48.png[/img]

The current vision is... a Garden🌺, with a hint of Dreams🎭 and a tiny bit of Surrealism🍩.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/293d5674323a033cec585a378a4e7801464aaa75.png[/img]
Remember the Dream Garden is not part of your duty as Planetary Architect! Build it for beauty, not scores! Well... actually, you can do whatever you want with it.

Unlike our Story Mode, the Dream Garden is in its early stage and will continue to evolve as we receive community feedback. Many parts of it may be subject to change. If something in the Garden clicks with you, please tell us!

The first Dream Garden update is slightly delayed due to the current heat wave in Japan🌞. If you are experiencing the effects of extreme weather, please stay safe too!

Rocket-in-Bottle Team
On behalf of Nekokami Co.

notes.title: 1 Week Left for Launch Discount✨, plus Bugfixes and Updates
notes.notes:
✨ Less than ONE week left for the EA-launch discount! ✨ Our next sale will be far away — likely at the end of the year — and it will NOT go below the current launch discount price. Check out our EA launch FAQ here to see if you should hop in now!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2840890/view/4196872969304237082]Should I join the Early Access?[/url]

We also released the first major post-launch update today. 

[list]
[*]✨Baozi System is available again! Finishing the Baozi system will lead you to the story milestone in our EA launch. 
[*]🐛Wetland surveying bug and other conversation bugs are fixed! Thank you for all the bug reports.
[*]🐛The Dream Garden launch issue has been fixed. 
[*]🔧Wide screen UI, MMB/RMB mouse dragging swapping and various user requested features are patched in.
[*]Previous minor patch link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2840890/view/4259923998303757388]Link[/url]
[/list]
[i]A dreamy oasis town for the Silver People. Prove you are one with the Great Desert, Planetary Architect![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889893/ed50c1ba0fdd19cf448857b77fcb10e9da9fef2a.png[/img]

We are very grateful for the planetary architect pioneers who have braved the Nekokami universe and made our launch a success!

[h2]📖A Clarification on the Mochi/Tempura Star Systems[/h2]
Story star systems (e.g. Mochi/Tempura) often require multiple (real-time) days to complete. This is to give the narratives a more realistic feeling. We wish to clarify this here because it may have given an impression that the star system is incomplete. It's not! Professor and Senpai are waiting for you!  

[h2]🌌New Story Contents?[/h2]
New story contents will be released in big, substantial batches. We aim for each new story content to add at least 8 to 10 hours of gameplay. The next new story content will happen in Q3 - we will reveal the details and roadmap in a revamped Company Intranet later.

[h2]🔧How About Visual/Feature Updates/Bug-Fixes?[/h2]
Visual and feature updates and bug fixes will be made available continuously during Early Access. This includes art polish, the Dream Garden, accessibility options, etc.

Thank you all for your support!

Rocket-in-Bottle Team 🚀
On behalf of Nekokami Co.

notes.title: Minor Post-Launch Update
notes.notes:
This is a post-launch day update containing fixes to several issues our awesome players have reported.

[list]
[*]Difficult setting should now be applied properly to all star systems. We would like to let you know that the difficulty experience will get optimized through out the Early Access period. 
[*]The Faith Bar display is now fixed.
[*]The Kami behind the Tile generation has been tamed a little so you won't as frequently get sad rolls. Also, Flower Tile frequency has been adjusted in some planets. 
[*]Several glitches to the portraits has been fixed. Chief Xia will get a new face soon, btw.
[*]Various other fixes.
[/list]

We will continue to provide close support to the launch build so that it will give the most wonderful experience to our early supporters. Thank you all!
